ability.name: Step 2 - Verify Nmap Availability
ability.description: Proof availability of Nmap scan suite dynamically on target path.

stages.command_template: $d='C:/Windows/Temp/bas'; if(!(Test-Path $d)){ni -ItemType Directory -Force $d|out-null}; $(try { $nmap_path = Get-Command nmap -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($nmap_path) { $v = nmap --version 2>&1 | Select-String 'Nmap'; Write-Output "NMAP_AVAILABLE: true"; Write-Output "NMAP_VERSION: $v" } else { Write-Output "NMAP_AVAILABLE: false" } } catch { "ERROR: $_" }) | Tee-Object -FilePath $d/step2.txt

rationale: Ensures downstream scanning stages gracefully switch between Nmap and PowerShell scan paths depending on operational tools.
